content.text:
Exactly one blocker is failing:

**Platelet count (rule CLIN-PLT-001, v2)** — PLT 82,000 falls in the AC (BRAJAC) reduced-dose band (70,000 to under 90,000); full dose requires 90,000. A prescriber dose decision is required before the chair. Evidence: EVT-DC-04-PLT.

All other gates pass, including ANC 2208 (ENC-DC-04-ANC-DERIVED), bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL (EVT-DC-04-BILI), the complete pre-cycle panel within 7 days (EVT-DC-04-HB, EVT-DC-04-WBC, EVT-DC-04-PLT, ENC-DC-04-ANC-DERIVED), lifetime doxorubicin 180 mg/m² (EVT-DC-04-DOXO1, EVT-DC-04-DOXO2), signed consent (DOC-DC-04-CONSENT) and order (DOC-DC-04-ORDER), and approved pre-authorisation (PA-DC-04).

The actual dose decision itself requires the treating practitioner's judgment. Note also the coverage advisory: the family-floater balance is not known (COV-DC-04).
